title: Two of three mode READMEs carry a version behind their own SKILL.md and newest changelog
description: mcp-chrome-devtools README declares 1.0.26.0 while its SKILL.md and newest changelog are 1.0.28.0; mcp-aside-devtools README declares 1.1.10.0 while its SKILL.md and newest changelog are 1.1.13.0; mcp-bladebro is consistent at 1.2.1.0. No checker enforces cross-file version equality under .skilled/bin or .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts.
scopeProof: All six files are inside the declared review target; the convention is stated by the hub own SKILL.md and README.md.
